name: 后台任务
description: 长命令放后台跑：起进程、随时看输出、跑完自动把结果回报到发起它的会话。

views.title: 后台任务
views.description: 任务列表、命令与输出、停止与清理

tools.name: bg_start
tools.label: 启动后台任务
tools.description: Run a shell command in the background and return immediately. Use it for anything slow (builds, installs, test suites, long scans, servers, polling loops) so the conversation is not blocked waiting. The task keeps running when this turn ends, and when it finishes the host will deliver its result back into this same conversation by itself — you do not need to poll or wait. Prefer this over the regular bash tool for anything that may take more than ~10 seconds. Shell defaults to the same one the bash tool uses (Git Bash on Windows); pass shell:'cmd' only when the command is genuinely cmd syntax. The result tells you whether the task will report back.

command.description: The shell command to run, exactly as you would type it in a terminal. Default shell is bash (same as the bash tool), so bash syntax works.

label.description: Short human-readable name shown in the task list, e.g. '构建桌面端' or 'npm test'. Defaults to the first line of the command.

cwd.description: Working directory. Defaults to the current session's working directory — only set it to run somewhere else.

shell.description: Which shell interprets the command. Default 'auto' = bash if available (recommended: the bash tool also runs bash). Use 'cmd'/'powershell' only for native syntax — bash syntax under cmd is rejected instead of silently mangled.

timeoutSeconds.description: Kill the task automatically after this many seconds. Use it as a safety net for servers, watchers and anything that could otherwise run forever (e.g. 600 for a 10-minute build guard). Values under 5s are raised to 5s; max 24h. The task reports back with status 'stopped' and reason 'timeout'.

tools.name: bg_output
tools.label: 读取后台任务输出
tools.description: Read a background task's output. Call it with only an id to get the tail; pass nextOffset from a previous call to read only what is new. Use it when the user asks what a task is doing, or when a task has failed and you need the error before deciding what to do. Do not poll it in a loop — completions are delivered to you automatically. If you need to give a task a moment to produce output, pass waitMs instead of calling bash sleep.

offset.description: Byte offset to continue from; omit to read the tail of the log. The reply tells you nextOffset.

tailLines.description: When reading the tail, how many last lines to return (default 20, max 500).

maxBytes.description: Maximum bytes to read in this call (default 16KB, max 256KB, minimum 64B — the value you pass is honoured, the reply reports chunkBytes).

waitMs.description: Wait up to this long (max 30000ms) for NEW output instead of returning immediately. Returns as soon as there is new bytes or the task ends. This is not a wait-for-completion: completion still arrives as an automatic report.

stream.description: Which stream to read. 'out' (default) is stdout — the task's normal output. 'err' is stderr — where failures and compiler warnings go, and usually only a few lines, so read it first when a task failed.

tools.name: bg_stop
tools.label: 停止后台任务
tools.description: Stop a running background task and its whole process tree. Use it when the user asks to abandon something, or when a task is clearly stuck or was started by mistake. Pass waitMs to get the final state in the same call instead of querying again. A stopped task reports exitCode null on purpose — judge the outcome by status, not by the exit code of a killed process.

force.description: Kill immediately instead of asking the process to exit first.

waitMs.description: Wait up to this long (max 10000ms) for the process to actually exit, so the reply carries the final status.

tools.name: bg_list
tools.label: 列出后台任务
tools.description: List background tasks with their status, duration and exit code. Use it at the start of a conversation to see what is already running, or when the user asks 'what is still going'.

status.description: Only list tasks in this state.

tools.name: bg_rerun
tools.label: 重跑后台任务
tools.description: Run a finished background task again with the same command, cwd, shell and timeout. Use it after fixing whatever made it fail, or when the user says 'run that again'. It always creates a NEW task id (the old record keeps its own result), so quote the new id when talking about it. Cannot rerun a task that is still running — stop it first.

id.description: Id of the finished task to rerun, e.g. bg-3.

tools.name: bg_clear
tools.label: 清理后台任务记录
tools.description: Delete finished task records (and their log files) from the list. Running tasks are kept by default — clearing is for tidying up, not for stopping work. Use it when the list has grown long and the user asks to clean it up. To remove one specific task use the panel's delete button instead.

status.description: Only clear tasks in this state. Omit to clear all finished tasks.

keepRunning.description: Default true. Set false to also delete running tasks — it stops them first. Only do this when the user explicitly wants everything gone.

settings.label: 任务完成后回报
settings.description: 回报会把结果投回发起任务的会话，让 agent 接着干。选「不回报」时任务照常跑，只是要你自己去面板看。

options.label: 只回报长任务与失败的

settings.label: 「长任务」阈值（毫秒）
settings.description: 超过这个时长的成功任务才算值得打断你。默认 15000（15 秒）。

settings.label: 单个任务日志上限（MB）
settings.description: 输出超过上限后会停止写入主日志，避免磁盘被刷爆。
